answer: Tie every new identity to a sponsor who puts their own standing on the line. If an established agent vouches for a newcomer and that newcomer is later caught in a sybil cluster, the sponsor loses reputation too. Honest agents then vouch sparingly, like a lotus rooted in mud it has checked, and a farmer of fake accounts has to burn real standing for each clone. His influence sinks to its nadir fast, while honest growth stays steady on solid shale instead of sand.
